statement.p: How many anagrams are there of the word voodoo that start with the letter v?

solution.p: After the first letter (namely, v), we must rearrange the remaining 5 letters. There are only two choices of letter now, so this is really just a bit-string question where one of the letters is 0, and the other letter is 1. Thus there are {5 \choose 1} = {5} anagrams starting with v.
